responsibility: Declares the entry point for the Rust unused-variable lint that runs on GCC backend declarations. It exposes UnusedVariables::Lint(Compile::Context&) as the small interface by which the Rust frontend hands compiled function, variable, and constant declaration state to the tree-walking warning implementation in the companion source file.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the minimal declaration of the UnusedVariables class and its static Lint(Compile::Context&) entry point, while the companion .cc file implements the tree walking and warning decisions.
